TECHCRUSH / Tbilisi Chase

A fictional arcade pursuit through a simplified reconstruction of central Tbilisi. Real street center lines, original building geometry, generated facade textures and an original interpretation of the photographed Baratashvili clock building. Buildings and terrain are not photogrammetry.

Street map

© OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License 1.0. Snapshot: 11 September 2026. Selected roads are simplified and widened, and traffic directions/temporary closures are adapted for play. Download the derived road database.

Sports car

Ferrari 458 model by vicent091036, distributed through the Three.js car example, attributed under CC BY 4.0. Geometry optimized for the browser; custom paint, track spoiler, police equipment, animation and game tuning added. The three selectable trims and their performance figures are fictional game configurations of the same base model. No affiliation with a vehicle manufacturer is implied.

Lighting and terrain

Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy HDRI by Greg Zaal and Aerial Rocks 02 surface by Rob Tuytel, CC0 / Poly Haven. The HDRI provides sky and reflections; the Tbilisi-inspired hills are original mesh geometry.

Art and code

Higgsfield GPT Image 2 generated the limestone facade, daylight asphalt and plane-tree textures for this project. TECHCRUSH logo and lettering were supplied by the user. Georgian flags, the tower, the clock-building interpretation and Kartlis Deda geometry were authored for the game. The supplied Street View and statue photographs were used as visual references and are not redistributed as textures.

Three.js: MIT license. Project-authored code: MIT. Brand and third-party art assets retain their own terms. Full provenance and reproducible source preparation are included with the source package.
